title: Dossier catalog and new-dossier creation in ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
You land on a page with a top bar reading "ANDS Studio" with the suffix "· dossier manager", followed by your user chip and four navigation chips: "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", and "Guided journey →".

The main heading is "Your product dossiers", with a button on the same line labeled "New dossier +". Below it, an explanatory paragraph begins "A Dossier ID is the permanent file for one product at Health Canada..." — the phrase "Dossier ID" has a dashed underline, and hovering or keyboard-focusing it pops up a plain-language definition ending "You reuse it forever. Request it at most 8 weeks before filing."

While data loads you see "Loading dossiers…". If you have none, a notice says "No dossiers yet. Create one to start building a submission."

Clicking "New dossier +" (which toggles to "Cancel") reveals an inline card with two labeled fields: "Dossier ID" (placeholder "e123456") and "Product name" (placeholder "Drugazole 10 mg tablet"). A button reads "Create & open →", changing to "Creating…" while busy. The Dossier ID is validated against a fixed pattern — one lowercase letter plus 6–7 digits — and an invalid entry shows the red error "Dossier ID must be one letter + 6–7 digits (e.g. e123456)". Note the form assumes you already hold a real Health Canada dossier ID; there is no lookup or request step here, and the pathway is fixed to CS-BE with no visible choice. On success you are routed straight into that dossier's Module 1 workspace.

Existing dossiers appear as a grid of clickable glass tiles. Each tile shows the dossier ID, the product title, a meta line such as "ANDS · CS-BE", a thin progress bar, and a status chip reading either "Ready to file" (green) or a count like "3/5 modules". Each tile also has a small "✕" delete button; clicking it opens a browser confirm dialog: "Delete dossier e123456 and all of its documents? This cannot be undone." Clicking anywhere else on a tile opens Module 1 of that dossier.

Inside a dossier, the top bar changes: "ANDS Studio" now links back to this catalog, subtitled with the product name, and a tab strip labeled "Modules" shows M1–M5, each prefixed with a state glyph ("✓" passed, "—" not applicable, "●" to-do). Right-side chips there are "Application Viewer", "Audit", "Portfolio", and "Journey". Any API failure on the catalog page (load, create, delete) surfaces as a raw error string in a red notice bar.
